title: LLMOps Audit Log Event Schema
description: Schema for security, compliance, and governance audit records in the LLMOps platform.

audit_id.description: Unique audit record ID, formatted as aud-<uuid>

ts.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the audited action

correlation_id.description: Correlation ID linking this audit entry to application logs and traces

action.description: Verb describing the operation (e.g., READ, EXECUTE, UPDATE, REDACT)

compliance_tags.description: Regulatory tags like GDPR-Art6, Decree13-VN-Art9, PCI-DSS-Req3

prev_hash.description: Cryptographic hash of the immediately preceding audit record for tamper-evidence

record_hash.description: SHA-256 HMAC or hash of this record ensuring immutable audit trail
